aviation_incidents.headline: FAA要求部分波音737 NG定期測試飛控系統 異常須修正並複測
aviation_incidents.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署發布適航指令，要求部分波音737 NG定期執行數位飛控系統的副翼內建測試，依結果修正及複測，估計影響約300架美國註冊飛機。擾流板位置資料異常可能使自動油門巡航推力差監控無法啟動；若兩具引擎推力差距過大，飛機可能意外滾轉，機組未及時修正恐失控。指令將於聯邦公報刊登後15天生效。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: FAA orders recurring flight-control tests on certain Boeing 737 NG aircraft
aviation_incidents.summary_en: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration issued an airworthiness directive requiring recurring aileron built-in tests on the digital flight-control systems of certain Boeing 737 NG aircraft, with corrective action and retesting as needed. It estimates about 300 U.S.-registered aircraft are affected; the directive takes effect 15 days after Federal Register publication. Missing or faulty spoiler-position data could prevent the autothrottle’s cruise thrust split monitor from activating. A large engine thrust difference could cause an unexpected roll and, if the crew fails to correct it in time, loss of control.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 長榮航空波音787-9新機 B-17891 傳自查爾斯頓啟程 飛往桃園
taiwan_aviation.summary: 消息指出，長榮航空波音787-9新機 B-17891 已從美國南卡羅來納州查爾斯頓啟程，目的地為桃園國際機場，並稱這是長榮今年第二架新機。機籍資料顯示，該機在查爾斯頓出廠，製造序號為68966。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: EVA Air’s new Boeing 787-9 B-17891 reportedly departs Charleston for Taoyuan
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: EVA Air’s new Boeing 787-9 B-17891 has reportedly departed Charleston, South Carolina, for Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport. A tip described it as the airline’s second new aircraft this year. Registry data list Charleston as its production site and 68966 as its manufacturer serial number.

international_aviation.headline: 聯合航空已為713架飛機裝設Starlink 約占機隊47%
international_aviation.summary: 聯合航空11月19日表示，已有713架飛機裝設Starlink，約占機隊47%，包括352架支線客機、353架窄體客機及8架寬體客機。公司仍以2027年底完成全機隊安裝為目標；旅客可於出發前3天內在官網查詢航班是否提供服務。
international_aviation.headline_en: United equips 713 aircraft with Starlink, about 47% of its fleet
international_aviation.summary_en: United Airlines said on November 19 that 713 aircraft, about 47% of its fleet, have Starlink: 352 regional aircraft, 353 narrowbodies and eight widebodies. It still aims to equip the entire fleet by the end of 2027. Passengers can check availability by flight number and date up to three days before departure.

sources.name: 聯合航空 Starlink 安裝進度

international_aviation.headline: 泰雷茲以三地據點支援亞太航空維修 盼拓展長期合約
international_aviation.summary: 泰雷茲以新加坡為亞太營運中心，並在北京及新德里設點；部分合約由公司備料並與航空公司預測需求，以利區域調度。越捷航空9月公布與泰雷茲簽訂按飛行時數計費的航電維修合約，涵蓋空中巴士A320及A330系列。泰雷茲盼將此模式推廣至其他亞太航空公司。
international_aviation.headline_en: Thales supports Asia-Pacific airline maintenance from three sites, seeks long-term contracts
international_aviation.summary_en: Thales supports Asia-Pacific airlines from its regional operating center in Singapore and sites in Beijing and New Delhi. Under some contracts, it holds stocks of designated equipment and forecasts demand with airlines to source parts within the region. In September, Vietjet announced a flight-hour-based maintenance contract with Thales covering avionics on Airbus A320 and A330 families. Thales hopes to extend this long-term support model to other airlines in the region.

international_aviation.headline: SkyWest將CRJ200改為41席CRJ450 首架預計2026年底前投入聯合航空支線
international_aviation.summary: SkyWest計畫將約50架龐巴迪CRJ200改裝為CRJ450，預計到2028年完成。新客艙規劃41席，包括7席頭等艙、16席加大腿部空間的經濟艙及18席一般經濟艙，也計畫設置手提行李櫃與Starlink Wi-Fi。首架預計2026年底前投入定期航班，以聯合航空的United Express品牌營運。
international_aviation.headline_en: SkyWest plans 41-seat CRJ450 conversions, first expected in United Express service by end of 2026
international_aviation.summary_en: SkyWest plans to convert about 50 Bombardier CRJ200s into CRJ450s by 2028. The 41-seat layout includes seven first-class seats, 16 extra-legroom economy seats and 18 standard economy seats, with a carry-on luggage closet and Starlink Wi-Fi planned. The first aircraft is expected to enter scheduled service by the end of 2026 under United Airlines’ United Express brand.

sources.name: SkyWest 向 SEC 提交的季報

international_aviation.headline: 美國眾議院中國問題特別委員會籲限制對中國航空業投資 建議不認證中國製飛機
international_aviation.summary: 美國眾議院中國問題特別委員會11月19日發布調查報告，建議限制對中國航空產業投資，並籲美國聯邦航空總署不認證中國製飛機。委員會主張部分西方業者與中方合作有助中國發展軍用航空能力，建議撤回與持續投資中國航空業的承包商簽訂的美國政府合約，報告點名空中巴士。相關限制仍屬建議，須待美國政府採取後續行動才會生效。
international_aviation.headline_en: U.S. House China panel urges investment curbs and no certification for Chinese-built aircraft
international_aviation.summary_en: The U.S. House Select Committee on China recommended limiting investment in China’s aerospace industry and urged the Federal Aviation Administration to withhold certification of Chinese-built aircraft. The panel argued that some Western partnerships had benefited China’s military aviation sector and proposed withdrawing U.S. government contracts from aerospace contractors that continue investing in China’s aerospace industry. Airbus was among the companies named. The proposals require further U.S. government action to take effect.

sources.name: 美國眾議院中國問題特別委員會

international_aviation.headline: 阿拉斯加航空與夏威夷航空機師12月表決首份共同協約 草案為期四年
international_aviation.summary: 阿拉斯加航空與夏威夷航空機師將於12月1日至22日表決首份共同團體協約草案，內容包括四年效期及統一薪資架構。兩個機師工會執行委員會歷經逾600天談判，11月10日同意將草案付諸會員表決；若獲通過，年資12年的寬體客機機長2027年適用時薪為493.41美元，2030年升至539.16美元，適用波音787及空中巴士A330、A330F機隊。
international_aviation.headline_en: Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines pilots to vote on first joint contract in December
international_aviation.summary_en: Pilots at Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines will vote December 1–22 on their first joint collective bargaining agreement, a four-year proposal with a common pay structure. The two pilot councils agreed on November 10 to submit it to members after more than 600 days of negotiations. If ratified, the applicable hourly rate for a widebody captain with 12 years’ seniority on a Boeing 787, Airbus A330 or A330F would be $493.41 in 2027, rising to $539.16 in 2030.
